[[Arrahhsh's Aegis]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] dropped by [[Arrahhsh Mountainclub]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Mount Qinkai]] (during [[Return of the Yeti]]) and [[Pongmei Valley]].

==Stats==
:[[Armor rating|Armor]]: 16 (Requires 9 [[Strength]])
:Received [[physical damage]] -2 (while in a [[Stance]])
:[[Health]] +45 (while in a Stance)

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following Strength shields:
**[[Bronze Shield]] from crafter [[Sheco]]
**[[Shield of the Lion]] from collector [[Wekekuda]]  or crafter [[Ruricu]]
OR
*One of the following Strength shields:
**[[Militia Shield]] from collector [[Danira]]
**[[Reinforced Buckler]] from collector [[Shaan]]
*[[Perfect]] "Run for your Life!" [[inscription]]
OR
*One of the following Strength shields:
**[[Shield of the Lion]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Shield]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Shield]] from collector [[Zaishen Martial Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Shield]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Norn Shield]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Shield]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Shield of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Shield of the Wing]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
**[[Charr Shield]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Shield]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Shield]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Shield]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*Perfect [[Shield Handle]] [[of Endurance]]
*Perfect "Run for your Life!" inscription

==Unique counterpart==
*[[Aegis of Clarity]] and [[Xun Rao's Quill]] have stats identical to this item.
*[[Grognar's Defender]] requires [[Tactics]], otherwise identical stats.
